The '''Battle of Botajef''' was a major battle between the [[Fel Empire]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] under the employ of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] late in the first year of the [[Sith–Imperial War]].

==The battle==
The Mandalorians, under the leadership of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Chernan Ordo]], had been hired to hold [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]] until the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|fleet]] arrived. However, in an act of betrayal, [[Yaga Auchs]], who worked for a third party that wanted the Mandalorians to withdraw from the war, sabotaged the communication center, killing one fellow Mandalorian and leaving [[Hondo Karr]] to die. He then left the planet, along with the majority of the forces.

Karr survived by putting on the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] of a dead [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] and pretending to be a surviving one. He joined the [[Joker Squad|Jokers]], a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] within the [[407th Stormtrooper Division]], under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ran Harkas]].
